title: Dynamic oRPC-to-OpenAPI Schema Pipeline with First-Class MCP Tool Annotations
summary: Architectural pattern in ChatbotX where 52 modular oRPC sub-routers are dynamically compiled into an OpenAPI 3.1 specification via OpenAPIGenerator and Zod schema converters, enriched with x-mcp operation metadata (destructiveHint, idempotentHint, readOnlyHint, scope), and ingested into an MCP server that automatically exposes public API endpoints as typed agent tools.

references.description: Dynamic OpenAPI document generator route with ETag caching and tenant scoping
Consolidated public router exporting 52 feature routers
OpenAPI loader transforming operations into MCP tools with token security filtering

claims.claim: oRPC public routers are translated into OpenAPI specifications on demand using @orpc/openapi OpenAPIGenerator and ZodToJsonSchemaConverter, cached in-process by tenant and origin for 300 seconds.
OpenAPI operations are decorated with x-mcp metadata tags (readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint, scope, visibility) to signal agent safety boundaries directly in the tool schema.

Security schemes are filtered to workspace-token operations only (bearerAuth, developerAccessToken, tokenInSearchParams), preventing tools with unavailable channel credentials from generating 401 errors.
